packages.label: עָלְמָא דְּאִתְכַּסְיָא — לֵאָה, הַלֵּב, וְרִקּוּדֵי הַחֲתֻנָּה
packages.label_en: The Hidden World — Leah, the Heart, and the Wedding Dance
packages.reason: All five concepts share the essential nature of Binah / Imma — the concealed upper world whose hidden light (the aleph of Ehyeh) flows downward to rectify the Shekhinah. עלמא דאתכסיא is explicitly the hidden world (Zohar Vayeitzei 154). לב is an aspect of עלמא דאתכסיא because the heart is where Torah is hidden ('in my heart I have hidden Your word'). לאה IS עלמא דאתכסיא (same Zohar source). 'אדני שפתי תפתח' IS the wedding dance (declared equivalent in the opening line). רקודין של חתנה is the moment when Binah's hidden light (drawn from Leah's hidden world through the heart) opens and sweetens the Shekhinah. All five are faces of the same concealed-becoming-revealed reality: Binah's hidden world expressing itself as the opening of the lips, the dance, and the zivug.

merge_notes.reason: CC-C was a 2-node isolated component. 'אדני שפתי תפתח' and רקודין של חתנה are declared equivalent ('IS the wedding dance') and represent the opening/revelation of Binah's hidden light — which is the essential nature of עלמא דאתכסיא. The source text makes explicit that the wedding dance draws the aleph from the heart (Leah/עלמא דאתכסיא) downward: 'לְהַמְשִׁיךְ מִלֵּאָה הָאַלְפִין'. The wedding dance and its verse are not a cause-effect appendage — they ARE the manifestation of Leah's hidden world becoming revealed. Merged by shared essential nature (Binah-revelation), not by eitza logic.

packages.label: שַׁ"ךְ הַדִּינִים — נַעַ"ר וַחֲמֵשׁ פְּעָמִים דִּין
packages.label_en: The 330 Judgments — The Unmarried Girl and the Five-Times-Din
packages.reason: All three concepts share the essential nature of the harsh judgments (dinnim) that afflict the Shekhinah in her uncorrected, un-betrothed state. ש"ך (330) is gematria of נע"ר (the young girl without the ה) — they are the same numerical reality named two ways. חמש פעמים דין (five times the word דין = 330) is the third face of the same reality. These are not causes of one another — they are three ways of expressing the same domain of harsh judgment that keeps the Kallah in the state of נַעַר (without the ה of Binah). They are the evil counter-force to Package 1: while Package 1 is the hidden light of Binah, Package 2 is the harsh judgment that blocks its flow.
